seed_record.construction_scope: same frozen image proposal tracked by16 existing safe scalar steps; no raw target map accepted/repaired

cost.feature_distance: eight-channel L1 in production; channel mean, not squared distance
cost.query_scope: identity residual vertex nodes plus nine raster offsets; nodal surrogate, not original raster energy
cost.mask_scope: immutable fixed patch samples/denominators; no moving overlap gating
cost.oob_scope: quadratic excess of A*(q+offset+label/image_side)+b with coefficient1
cost.label_order: zero first then(x,y)lexicographic; exact ties first minimum

coupling.coupling_scope: UNWEIGHTED all interior nodes, divided by fixed Z
coupling.screened_equation: (2c I + strain_weight*Z/image_side^2 G)u=2c z; G=P.T Kfine P
coupling.contrast_to_ConvexAdam: same six schedule values, exact screened Galerkin solve instead of local averaging

seed_record.initial_center: identity residual after original frozen affine; no existing deformation field

selected_stage_scope: None=identity residual, -1=constructed coupled seed or accepted capture prefix, nonnegative=ordinary stage index

image_match_evidence.path_check: raster basenames plus side and sampling-affine values; relocated paths allowed, not content identity proof
image_match_evidence.mask: fixed target coordinate inside original moving rectangle; no adaptive query dropping
